name: Foreign Study Loan Scheme (GUEEDC)
briefDescription: Loan scheme offering up to ₹15 lakh at 4% simple interest to unreserved category students for MBBS, PG, or equivalent courses abroad with flexible collateral and repayment conditions.
descriptionMd: The scheme provides **financial loan assistance** to students from the **unreserved category** to pursue **higher education abroad.** Loans up to **₹15 lakh** are granted at simple interest of **4% per annum**, with flexible repayment options. Security and repayment conditions depend on the loan amount. This scheme aims to support meritorious, economically weaker students for global education opportunities.
benefitsMd:
**Loan Amount:** Up to ₹15.00 lakh **Interest Rate:** Simple interest at 4% per annum **Collateral:** **Up to ₹7.50 lakh:** Property valued at 1.5 times the loan amount **Above ₹7.50 lakh:** Property equal to the loan amount **Loan Repayment:** **Up to ₹5 lakh:** repay in 5 years after 1-year moratorium **Above ₹5 lakh**: repay in 6 years after 1-year moratorium
**Borrower can pre-pay without penalty**
eligibilityMd: 1. The applicant must be a **citizen of India** and a **resident of Gujarat.**1. The applicant must belong to the **Unreserved category**.1. The applicant must have passed **Class 12 with 60% or more marks**.1. The applicant must be seeking admission to **MBBS, Master’s, PG Diploma, or equivalent programs abroad.**1. The applicant’s annual family income must be **₹6.00 lakh or less.**
applicationMd:
1. Visit the Official Website:[ **https://gueedc.gujarat.gov.in**](https://gueedc.gujarat.gov.in)1. Click on “**Register**” and fill in your basic details such as name, email, mobile number, and create a password.1. **Login** to Your Account.1.  From the dashboard, select the “**Foreign Study Loan**” scheme .1. Fill the Online Application Form.
1. Upload Required Documents.
1. Submit the Application.
1.  Save or note down your **unique application ID** for future reference.1. Print the Application Form.
1. Submit the signed hard copy and original documents for verification **at the GUEEDC office or as directed**.
